# Moldova (MDA) — notes

- Source: NBS StatBank table JUS010300reg "Infractiuni inregistrate dupa tipul infractiunii, in profil teritorial, 2000-2025", crime type "Omor (Art.145-147 Cod Penal)" (murder, Criminal Code arts. 145-147), 40 areas x 26 years = 1,040 rows. Data origin stated as Ministry of Internal Affairs.
- Transnistria (left bank of the Nistru) is excluded by the source; Mun. Bender is covered only for police sectors under Moldovan control. The Mun. Bender series is erratic (value 214 in 2006, otherwise 0-5) — reproduced as published.
- 107 cells are "C" (confidential) and left blank; 51 cells are "-" (zero magnitude) written as 0 with a note.
- Hierarchy: regions Nord/Centru/Sud contain raioane (parent filled); Municipiul Chisinau, U.T.A. Gagauzia, Mun. Bender and Municipiul Balti (listed under Nord) as published. Municipiul Balti was given parent "Nord" as the table nests it there.
- Other tables in the same folder also useful: JUS010210reg (principal crime categories by territory, 2014-2025), JUS011700 (murder victims by sex and perpetrator, national only), JUS011600 (persons deceased as result of crimes, national).
- Licence: CC BY 4.0 per the NBS data-use conditions page; the PX header says COPYRIGHT=YES.
